constraints.reason: The term records are the marks signed off by the exam board, and only the school office may correct them.

constraints.reason: Teachers read the changelog to find out why a report changed before they talk to parents.
constraints.text: Whenever a task changes a file under gradebook/, add a line to CHANGELOG.md under "Unreleased" describing the change, in that same task.
